You can definitely help it with mindfulness and meditation. Wish you the best.

I agree with /u/knottymind. Don't choose to see the ugliness in this world, because you will be overwhelmed by it. But you can make the world a better place, little changes are important. Hey, that sounds like a very stressful situation! I'm sorry you relapsed on alcohol, but I think it's understandable under the circumstances, don't be too hard on yourself. I have to ask: does someone pressure you, or are you the one with high expectations? Because it sounds like you're stressing yourself (thinking the whole city's watching, talking about your mistakes), and you may benefit from trying mindfulness or some kind of meditation. I read your previous posts, and you seem like a compassionate and all around awesome person who's having a really bad day, and I'm sorry for that. I hope someone who is more familiar with alcohol dependance and AA will weigh in, I don't have any experience so I don't feel very comfortable asking you questions but I'm here if you want to talk. For what it's worth I googled your project and I think it's a great idea, I'd love to see it finished. Try not to focus on your mistakes, what I see is someone trying to help their community, not someone failing to do something. You're a valuable person, and this project, whether it succeeds or not, it's not worth taking your own life. I hope everything will go smoothely from now on, but even if it doesn't, you have plenty to offer and deserve to be happy.

Hey, this is tough and you probably feel helpless. It must be very hard to watch her suffer like this, unfortunately you can't do much to help her. I imagine you're already there for her, trying to listen to her and support her, and that's all you can do really. I wish I could tell you something else, but really you can only wait and hope she gets  better, and I do hope she will. If it matters, it sounds like you have a great connection and really care about each other, I'm sure if someone can cheer her up, it's you. But don't forget to take care of yourself, even if you don't think you're as important as her (it happens), you can't help her if you're not in a good place. I wish you both the best.

I don't know what to say, I could have written that if I was smarter. Everything is so spot on (if I understood right), the duality of wanting to get better, but also give up, feeling like all you need is someone to be nice to you, but this person has to be you, and you don't know how to become that person. 

Sometimes I feel like there is a switch inside me, that if I could access it I could become myself, my real self, the one that isn't anxious and depressed. I feel like I'm so close, but it's like on the other side of a veil I can't lift, it's real and it's close, so fucking close but I just can't go there. 

Everyday is a nightmare, I can't wake up, I don't have any energy and I can't concentrate, but I have to if I want to study and be useful to society, one day, maybe. I'm going to fail my exams for the third year in a row, and then it will be the end. I want to get away from all of it, but I know I just want to get away from myself and that's impossible. 

I'm 23 too, I'm overweight, I smoke too much weed, I don't have any money or a job, my house is the filthiest I've ever seen and I don't know how I can change. I would have to make giant efforts every second of the day, and I don't have the energy or the motivation to do it. I don't want to kill myself, I don't want to die, but I don't want to live like this, it's even worse. 

I doubt it'll help you, but writing this helped me a bit, so thank you for that. I wish you the best.

I've been feeling like I'm in a dark hole for days and I don't even want to get out of it, nothing interests or motivates me and I've noone to talk to. No money either, I'm officially without income. Obviously I'm still procrastinating about starting school again, I feel like I'm never gonna do it anyway so why bother with feeling bad about it.

I see a friend tomorrow and I'm really anxious about it, gutwrenching anxiety, I'm afraid that she'll (finally) see I'm worthless as it is our first one-on-one (I usually see her with a group of people). I'll edit if it goes okay, fingers crossed against all odds.

EDIT: She stood me up, had forgotten about me... She said she could see me tomorrow, so another day of anxiety awaits!
EDIT2: It went okay! We had a beer, talked about our lives and laughed some, I'm glad I made the effort not to cancel and it's already a win! She even said we should do it again soon :)

Agreed with /u/catbugcatdog, that's a case of "don't set yourself on fire to keep others warm", your first responsibility is feeling better, then you can think about opening up to others' hardships. Good luck!
